summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Catalogue of astrological chapters in a Venetian codex, cross-referenced chiefly to Florentine codex 8: planetary states, rains, inceptions, city foundations, iatromathematics, medical prognostics, phlebotomy and purgation, disease methods, and the hexagonal figure. Named works include writings by Hephaestion, Hermes Trismegistus, Galen, Pancharios, Petosiris, Astrampsychos, Stephanus of Alexandria, Theophilus, Nechepso, Heliodorus, and a Syrian astrologer.
